The central figure is a female graduate holding a diploma, flanked by a male graduate in a blue gown on the left and others in the background. The image captures a celebratory moment at a graduation ceremony.

Collars of shirts or blouses are visible beneath the neckline of the gowns, indicating they are worn over other clothing.
